newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ manufacturers t/o, profits fell in Mch qtr - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ manufacturers t/o, profits fell in Mch qtr - SNZ.

text.p: Sales by New Zealand manufacturers in the March quarter continued to fall, extending the trend of the last three quarters, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday. The trend estimate fell 0.1 percent, quarter on quarter, SNZ said in a statement.
The agency added that in the quarter the net profit before tax for all manufacturing industries was NZ$983 million, down 13.5 percent on the year-ago quarter.
